verdict.rationale: three.js is documented as a cross-browser WebGL/WebGPU library, and a community report says it runs on "pretty much any device via the web browser." One project can therefore reach desktop and mobile users, but only as browser content, not through any export pipeline. There is no evidence of console targets, direct or via partners. missing for 10: native desktop/mobile export or packaging, console export (direct or via partners), first-party platform-target documentation.
